entry.title: Katie Holmes, Boyfriend Jason Bard Yarmosky Have Red Carpet Date Night | E! News

media:group.media:title: Katie Holmes, Boyfriend Jason Bard Yarmosky Have Red Carpet Date Night | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Katie Holmes’ romance is seriously en pointe. The 'Dawson’s Creek' alum proved she and boyfriend Jason Bard Yarmosky still have the sweetest love connection as they enjoyed a date night at New York City’s Lincoln Center for the American Ballet Theatre fall gala honoring Cynthia Erivo Oct. 29. The two kept close on the red carpet, holding hands as they posed for photos. Holmes—who shares daughter Suri, 20, with ex-husband Tom Cruise—looked lovely in a silky, long-sleeved dark green gown that elongated her torso with a drop-waist. The 47-year-old kept her hair pulled back in a bun for the evening and completed her look with dangling earrings and a black bag. Yarmosky looked equally dashing, wearing a dark, double-breasted suit over a black shirt, which perfectly complemented his better half. The couple first sparked romance rumors in July when Holmes stepped out hand-in-hand with the artist at a screening of Olivia Wilde’s 'The Invite' in the Hamptons, New York. entry.title: William Shatner, Hugh Jackman & More React to Patrick Stewart's Death | E! News

media:group.media:title: William Shatner, Hugh Jackman & More React to Patrick Stewart's Death | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Honoring Patrick Stewart: Make it so. The 'Star Trek' icon died on Oct. 28 at age 86 after a brief battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia, with many in Hollywood mourning the loss. "Sir Patrick Stewart was a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor," Star Trek: The Original Series' William Shatner wrote on Instagram Oct. 29. "From the stage to the bridge of the Enterprise, he brought intelligence, grace, and a deep sense of humanity to everything he did." He continued, "Captain Picard stood for the best of us, and so did the man who played him. I was filled with affection and admiration for him and his work." It was a sentiment shared by Shatner's castmate George Takei, who wrote on his own Instagram, "Our hearts are heavy, indeed. Rest in the heavens, Captain." Stewart’s 'X-Men' costar Hugh Jackman also paid tribute, writing on Instagram, “We lost one of the greats of stage and screen today. And, in my book, a tremendous friend and man. I learned so much from him. I will miss you, Patrick Stewart, all of my days.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/photos/38403/patrick-stewart-dead-stars-pay-tribute

entry.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek & X-Men Actor, Dead at 86 | E! News

media:group.media:title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek & X-Men Actor, Dead at 86 | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Patrick Stewart is going towards that final frontier. The actor—best known for starring as Captain Jean-Luc Picard on 'Star Trek: The Next Generation' and as Professor Charles Xavier in the 'X-Men' film franchise—died on Oct. 28 at the age of 86 following a brief battle with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia, his family confirmed. “He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” a statement posted to Stewart’s Instagram Oct. 29 read. “We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.” They continued, “His sonorous voice and singular talent will forever be synonymous with indelible performances in every genre. He explored the human condition in all its poetic complexity and brought hope not only to the far reaches of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but into science fiction's most iconic final frontier aboard the Starship Enterprise.” In 1966 he married first wife Sheila Falconer—with whom he shared son Daniel Stewart and daughter Sophie Stewart—although they divorced in 1990. A decade later he tied the knot with producer Wendy Neuss. However, their marriage was short-lived, with them splitting in 2003. For Stewart, the third time ultimately proved to be the charm as five years after their chance meeting during his run of Macbeth, he and singer-songwriter Sunny Ozell wed—with their 2013 ceremony officiated by McKellan.

entry.title: Colin Farrell’s Son James Makes Rare Appearance in HBO Doc Trailer | E! News

media:group.media:title: Colin Farrell’s Son James Makes Rare Appearance in HBO Doc Trailer | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Colin Farrell shared a rare glimpse into his family life with 23-year-old son James Farrell, who lives with a rare neurogenetic disorder called Angelman syndrome, in The Slightest Touch trailer. In a newly released trailer for the HBO Max documentary The Slightest Touch detailing his and Emma Fogarty’s journey running the 2024 Dublin marathon, Colin said, "I've never had a camera crew come near my home." He then was shown laughing and hugging James, who he shares with ex Kim Bordenave. The Banshees of Inisherin actor—who's also dad to son Henry Farrell, 16, with ex Alicja Bachleda-Curús—will not stand in the way of someone living a full life. After all, he wants the same with James, whose condition causes developmental delays and trouble with speech.
